AI Overview
Flagle is a daily online geography and flag-guessing game inspired by Wordle. 
You can play the official daily game on the Flagle - The Daily Flag Guessing Game website. 
Flagle
How to Play
Objective: Guess the hidden country flag in 6 tries or fewer. 
Flagle
The Grid: The flag is initially hidden behind a grid (often a 3x3 layout) with one or more tiles already visible. 
Revealing Clues: Each time you enter a wrong country guess, another section of the flag is uncovered. 
Kveez
 +1
Direction and Distance: After each incorrect guess, the game shows you the distance in kilometers from your guessed country's capital to the target country's capital, along with a directional arrow (such as ↗️ for north-east). 
Kveez
Where to Play
Web Browsers: Flagle - The Daily Flag Guessing Game or alternative platforms like Flagle and Flagle Game.
